EtherCAT version. Add -R to the part nu: Xenus Plus XEL servo drive 6 Adc continuous with EtherCAT
column3: 1 axis; EtherCAT CoE with CiA 402 csp + csv + cst; continuous 6 Adc (4.24 Arms); peak 18 Adc (12.7 Arms) for 1 s; supply 1 or 3 phase 100 to 240 VAC (bus about 325 V at 230 VAC); current loop 16 kHz; velocity and position loops 4 kHz; encoder quad A/B + 1 Vpp sin/cos + EnDat + BiSS + SSI + Absolute A; +5 V encoder supply 400 mA; motor temperature input AIN3; regen switch for an external resistor (cut-in 390 Vdc); size 201.2 x 139.9 x 58.7 mm
